reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Widening AI gap for developing nations
themes.definition: The AI gap between states, beyond the digital gap, that prevents developing countries from using AI for development due to inadequate infrastructure.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing an AI or digital divide limiting developing countries' use of AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude requests for assistance with no description of the gap (AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING).
themes.boundary_cases: Passages that both describe the divide and request technology transfer are coded here and AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: An even greater gap is being created in relation to artificial intelligence.

themes.label: Technology transfer and technical assistance
themes.definition: Calls for technology transfer, capacity-building and technical assistance so developing countries can leverage AI and digital tools.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit requests for technology transfers, capacity-building or technical assistance related to AI/digital technologies.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general development finance requests unrelated to technology.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls to 'bridge the digital divide' with assistance count here and AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: promote meaningful technology transfers, ensure equitable access for developing nations, bridge the digital divide
we call for increased capacity-building and technical assistance to bridge the global digital divide

themes.label: AI accelerating sustainable development
themes.definition: AI presented as an opportunity to accelerate sustainable development and growth.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI offers opportunities for sustainable development or is a development tool.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages only about gaps without development benefits.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Using AI as a development tool' within a divide passage can be coded both.

examples.quote: Digital technologies and artificial intelligence offer unprecedented opportunities to accelerate sustainable development.

themes.label: Ethical guidelines and international law compliance
themes.definition: Responsible, ethical AI consistent with international law and IHL, including national AI ethical guidelines and humanity's interests.
themes.inclusion: Include references to AI ethical guidelines, responsible use, and compliance with international (humanitarian) law.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for regulation that do not reference ethics or law principles.
themes.boundary_cases: IHL references imply military uses; code AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS only if weapons/warfare are explicit.

examples.quote: We have developed national AI ethical guidelines in line with international frameworks.
The interest of humanity must always guide the development and use of these technologies.

themes.label: Urgent regulatory regime for AI
themes.definition: Calls to address the absence of a regulatory or supervisory regime for AI and new technologies in cyberspace.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for regulation or supervisory regimes for AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude national regulations described as achievements (AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: Partnership-based cybersecurity approaches without AI regulation go to AI_CYBER_SECURITY.

examples.quote: The absence of a regulatory supervisory regime concerning the use of new technologies in cyberspace and in artificial intelligence needs to be addressed urgently.

themes.label: AI spreading disinformation and disruption
themes.definition: Concern that AI and cyber technologies spread disinformation and undermine established scientific findings.
themes.inclusion: Include mentions of AI-enabled disinformation or undermining facts.
themes.exclusion: Exclude cyberattacks on infrastructure without information content.

examples.quote: spread disinformation and undermine scientifically established findings

themes.label: Proposal for neutral sovereign AI zone
themes.definition: A specific proposal to the Assembly to establish a neutral sovereign artificial intelligence zone.
themes.inclusion: Include proposals for neutral, sovereign or non-aligned AI zones or spaces.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general data-sovereignty claims without an institutional proposal.
themes.boundary_cases: If a proposal is framed mainly around independence from powerful states, also code AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: I present this August Assembly a proposal to set up a neutral sovereign artificial intelligence zone.

value.rationale: Sri Lanka's passages centre on AI as a development opportunity blocked by a divide, with requests for capacity-building, plus ethics/international-law framing, an early call for regulation and disinformation concerns, and a unique neutral AI zone proposal.
